note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (t1_right is stored as int 0/1, t1_cap_hit as bool) and studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/sft1_cue-01/per_problem.json (score_v3 int 0/1, cap_hit bool); both are in the repo, 500 rows, one row per problem_index, so the 'first row' rule does not come into play. Inner join on problem_index; kept = t1_right non-null and score_v3 non-null. 'true' is read as True or == 1. Main: B right = t1_right true and t1_cap_hit not true; other right = score_v3 == 1 and cap_hit not true; gap = other right and not B right; statistic = gap rows with t1_cap_hit true / gap rows. Under this reading a T1 cap hit counts as not right even when t1_right is 1, so it can join the gap and the numerator. alt_measured drops both 'cap_hit not true' clauses (right = grade only), so T1 cap hits graded right stay out of the gap. n is the gap size (the denominator). The bootstrap resamples all kept joined problems (2,000 resamples, seed 0) and recomputes the gap each time; a resample with an empty gap scores 0.0, which is unlikely unless the gap is very small. An empty gap on the full data prints not_computable, since refuted_by is null and the recipe does not count it as refuted.
